"""Bounded read-only integration check of the six persisted promotion/base runs."""
import argparse
import json
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from decimal import Decimal as D
from pathlib import Path

import pyarrow.parquet as pq

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--package', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
package = args.package.resolve()
if args.output.exists():
    raise FileExistsError(args.output)
sys.path.insert(0, str(package/'herramientas'))
import report_historical_rules_sensitivity as report
import verify_rules_sensitivity_package as verify

start_time = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
index_path = package/'indice_corridas.json'
index_sha_start = verify.sha256(index_path)
items = [x for x in verify.read_json(index_path)['runs'] if x['scenario'] in
         {'BASE_E3', 'BTC_PROMO_REALIZADA', 'BTC_PROMO_DECISION'}]
expected = {(s, p) for s in ('BASE_E3', 'BTC_PROMO_REALIZADA', 'BTC_PROMO_DECISION')
            for p in ('conditional', 'permanent')}
assert {(x['scenario'], x['strategy']) for x in items} == expected and len(items) == 6
protected = {}
results, internal = [], {}
promo_start = verify.timestamp('2022-07-08T14:00:00Z')
promo_end = verify.timestamp('2023-03-22T00:00:00Z')
signal_fields = ('symbol', 'time_ns', 'anchor', 'history_start', 'forecast',
                 'no_change', 'valid', 'forecast_reason')
for name in ('report_historical_rules_sensitivity.py', 'verify_rules_sensitivity_package.py'):
    protected['herramientas/'+name] = verify.sha256(package/'herramientas'/name)

for item in items:
    assert item['status'] in verify.SUCCESS and item['engine_status'] == 'complete'
    manifest = verify.check_run(package, item)
    run = package/item['path']
    for name in [*manifest['output_hashes'], 'run_manifest.json', 'run_manifest.sha256']:
        protected[item['path']+'/'+name] = verify.sha256(run/name)
    raw = verify.read_csv(run/'equity_daily.csv')
    daily, asset_daily = verify.financial_daily(raw, D(manifest['config']['capital']))
    periods = verify.periods(manifest['config'])
    financial = verify.period_financials(daily, periods)
    by_period = {r['period']: r for r in financial}
    for old in verify.read_csv(run/'metrics.csv'):
        new = by_period[old['period']]
        for field in ('net_return', 'cagr', 'sharpe', 'annual_volatility',
                      'max_drawdown', 'max_drawdown_days'):
            verify.assert_close(old[field], new[field], item['run_id']+'/'+field)
    primitives = {name: pq.read_table(run/(name+'.parquet')).to_pylist()
                  for name in ('signals', 'ledger', 'fills', 'orders', 'risk_events')}
    exposure = report.exposure_summary(primitives['ledger'], periods,
                                       D(manifest['config']['hedge_tolerance']))
    execution = report.execution_periods(primitives, periods)
    execution_native = verify.read_csv(run/'execution_summary.csv')
    for old in execution_native:
        new = next(r for r in exposure if r['period'] == 'full' and r['symbol'] == old['symbol'])
        for field in ('invested_seconds', 'unhedged_seconds', 'cash_seconds'):
            if old.get(field):
                verify.assert_close(old[field], new[field], item['run_id']+'/'+field)
    native_portfolio = next(r for r in execution_native if r['symbol'] == 'PORTFOLIO')
    assert int(native_portfolio['fills']) == len(primitives['fills'])
    assert int(native_portfolio['native_fill_count']) == len(primitives['fills'])
    h1_evaluation = verify.read_csv(run/'forecast_evaluation.csv')
    h1_stored = verify.read_csv(run/'h1_summary.csv')
    h1_rebuilt = verify.h1_summaries(h1_evaluation, periods)
    for old in h1_stored:
        new = next(r for r in h1_rebuilt if r['period'] == old['period'] and r['symbol'] == old['symbol'])
        for field in ('observations', 'excluded', 'mae_ewma', 'mae_no_change'):
            verify.assert_close(old[field], new[field], 'H1/'+field, D('1E-15'))
    h1_hashes = dict(
        forecast_evaluation=verify.economic_digest(h1_evaluation),
        h1_summary=verify.economic_digest(h1_stored),
        signal_forecasts=verify.economic_digest([{k: r.get(k) for k in signal_fields}
                                                 for r in primitives['signals']]),
    )
    opportunity = verify.read_csv(run/'opportunity_daily.csv')
    assert len(opportunity) == 1704 and all(verify.yes(r['complete']) for r in opportunity)
    h3_info = dict(native_daily_rows=len(opportunity),
                   native_daily_sha256=verify.economic_digest(opportunity))
    h3_path = package/'h3_minutos'/(item['run_id']+'.csv')
    if h3_path.is_file():
        source = verify.read_csv(h3_path)
        assert all(r['run_id'] == item['run_id'] and r['scenario'] == item['scenario']
                   and r['strategy'] == item['strategy'] for r in source)
        reconstructed = verify.h3_from_assets(source)
        observed = {r['date']: r for r in opportunity}
        assert len(source) == 3408 and len(reconstructed) == len(observed)
        for new in reconstructed:
            old = observed[new['date']]
            assert new['complete'] == verify.yes(old['complete'])
            for field in ('opportunity', 'eligible_fraction'):
                verify.assert_close(old[field], new[field], 'H3/'+field, D('1E-14'))
        h3_info.update(per_asset_status='passed', source_file=h3_path.relative_to(package).as_posix(),
            source_sha256=verify.sha256(h3_path), asset_days=len(source),
            asset_minutes=sum(int(r['minutos_totales']) for r in source),
            unknown_asset_minutes=sum(int(r['minutos_desconocidos']) for r in source),
            eligible_minutes_by_asset={symbol: sum(int(r['minutos_elegibles']) for r in source
                                                   if r['symbol'] == symbol) for symbol in verify.SYMBOLS})
        protected[h3_path.relative_to(package).as_posix()] = verify.sha256(h3_path)
    else:
        assert item['scenario'] == 'BASE_E3'
        h3_info.update(per_asset_status='not_checked_in_this_bounded_control',
            reason='Archived BASE has no per-asset minute table; declared reconstruction awaits final H3 provenance.')
    fee_checks = 0
    promo_btc_spot = []
    for fill in primitives['fills']:
        moment = int(fill['window_start'])
        promotional = item['scenario'] != 'BASE_E3' and fill['symbol'] == 'BTCUSDT' and fill['market'] == 'spot' and promo_start <= moment < promo_end
        expected_fee = D('0') if promotional else D('0.001') if fill['market'] == 'spot' else D('0.0005')
        assert D(fill['fee_rate']) == expected_fee, (item['run_id'], fill['fill_id'], 'fee_rate')
        fee_checks += 1
        if fill['symbol'] == 'BTCUSDT' and fill['market'] == 'spot' and promo_start <= moment < promo_end:
            promo_btc_spot.append({k: fill[k] for k in ('fill_id', 'time_ns', 'side', 'quantity', 'fee_rate')})
    threshold_checks = 0
    for signal in primitives['signals']:
        low_cost = item['scenario'] == 'BTC_PROMO_DECISION' and signal['symbol'] == 'BTCUSDT' and promo_start <= int(signal['time_ns']) < promo_end
        expected_cost = D('0.0014') if low_cost else D('0.0034')
        assert D(signal['estimated_cycle_cost']) == expected_cost, (item['run_id'], signal['time_ns'], 'decision_cost')
        threshold_checks += 1
    full = by_period['full']
    full_execution = next(r for r in execution if r['period'] == 'full')
    result = dict(scenario=item['scenario'], strategy=item['strategy'], run_id=item['run_id'],
        status=item['status'], engine_status=item['engine_status'],
        manifest_sha256=item['manifest_sha256'], run_artifacts_checked=len(manifest['output_hashes']),
        code_files_checked=len(manifest['code_files']), code_hash=manifest['code_hash'],
        days=len(daily), periods=len(periods),
        max_daily_pnl_residual_usdt=max(abs(r['reconciliation_residual_usdt']) for r in daily),
        max_daily_balance_residual_usdt=max(abs(r['balance_residual_usdt']) for r in daily),
        max_period_pnl_residual_usdt=max(abs(r['reconciliation_residual_usdt']) for r in financial),
        full_metrics=full, full_execution=full_execution,
        h1=h1_hashes, h3=h3_info, realized_fee_checks=fee_checks,
        decision_cost_checks=threshold_checks, btc_spot_promotion_fills=promo_btc_spot)
    results.append(result)
    internal[(item['scenario'], item['strategy'])] = dict(item=item, result=result, daily=daily,
        h1=h1_hashes, h3=opportunity, h3_digest=verify.economic_digest(opportunity))

comparisons = []
for (scenario, strategy), values in internal.items():
    base = internal[('BASE_E3', strategy)]
    assert values['h1'] == base['h1'], (scenario, strategy, 'H1 exact invariance')
    peer = internal[(scenario, 'permanent' if strategy == 'conditional' else 'conditional')]
    assert values['h3_digest'] == peer['h3_digest'], (scenario, 'H3 portfolio independence')
    static = scenario != 'BTC_PROMO_DECISION'
    if static:
        assert values['h3_digest'] == base['h3_digest'], (scenario, strategy, 'H3 static invariance')
    if scenario == 'BASE_E3':
        continue
    comparator_name = report.COMPARATORS[scenario]
    other = internal[(comparator_name, strategy)]
    full, prior = values['result']['full_metrics'], other['result']['full_metrics']
    delta_components = {key: full[key]-prior[key] for key in verify.COMPONENTS}
    delta_equity = full['final_equity_usdt']-prior['final_equity_usdt']
    verify.assert_close(delta_equity, sum((delta_components[k] for k in verify.COMPONENTS[:-1]), D(0)), 'delta attribution')
    divergent = [r['date'] for r, old in zip(values['daily'], other['daily'])
                 if r['equity_usdt'] != old['equity_usdt']]
    h3_changed = [r['date'] for r, old in zip(values['h3'], other['h3'])
                  if verify.economic_digest([r]) != verify.economic_digest([old])]
    comparisons.append(dict(scenario=scenario, strategy=strategy, run_id=values['item']['run_id'],
        comparator=comparator_name, comparator_run_id=other['item']['run_id'],
        delta_equity_usdt=delta_equity, delta_components_usdt=delta_components,
        equity_days_different=len(divergent), first_equity_divergence=divergent[0] if divergent else None,
        h3_days_different=len(h3_changed), h1_exact_invariance=True, h3_equal_between_portfolios=True,
        h3_expected_static_invariance=static,
        delta_fills=values['result']['full_execution']['fills']-other['result']['full_execution']['fills'],
        delta_openings=values['result']['full_execution']['openings']-other['result']['full_execution']['openings']))

for name, digest in protected.items():
    assert verify.sha256(package/name) == digest, 'Read-only preservation failed: '+name
out = dict(schema='rules_sensitivity_promotion_persisted_control_v1', status='passed',
    created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), started_at=start_time,
    scope='Six completed persisted runs only: BASE_E3 and both BTC_PROMO scenarios, two independent portfolios each. Not a complete batch report.',
    scenarios_still_running='Outside scope; no statuses assigned or modified by this control.',
    no_backtests_executed=True, final_comparison_not_generated=True, package_not_sealed=True,
    baseline_h3_per_asset='Not claimed here; native daily invariance verified, declared per-asset reconstruction pending final provenance.',
    index_sha256_at_start=index_sha_start, index_sha256_at_end=verify.sha256(index_path),
    index_may_evolve='Runner may append completed scenarios concurrently; this control retains its explicit six-run scope.',
    input_artifacts_preserved=len(protected), input_artifact_hashes=protected,
    daily_reconciliations=sum(r['days'] for r in results), period_reconciliations=sum(r['periods'] for r in results),
    run_results=results, comparisons=comparisons,
    command=[sys.executable, '-B', '-X', 'utf8', str(Path(__file__).resolve()), '--package', str(package), '--output', str(args.output.resolve())],
    python=sys.version, checker_script_sha256=verify.sha256(__file__),
    checker_script_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
    exit_code=0)
args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with args.output.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
    json.dump(out, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str, allow_nan=False)
    handle.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed', runs=len(results), daily_reconciliations=out['daily_reconciliations'],
    period_reconciliations=out['period_reconciliations'], comparisons=comparisons,
    output=str(args.output.resolve())), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
